repair: Replace mixed arm ownership with a complete connected partition: hand 244, forearm 158, upper-arm 169 original triangles; retain 2429 torso/rest triangles. Anatomical classification uses triangle connectivity and actual wrist/elbow/shoulder loops rather than inherited bad weight labels.

Close both sides of the 14-edge wrist, 28-edge elbow and 27-edge shoulder articulation loops. Add 414 cap rows and 138 triangles; reuse an existing stone UV patch without changing original textures or UV rows.

Drive the three rigid stones through physical joint centres with a small parallel support chain. Reuse original local rotation/scale samplers where appropriate to inherit continuous hierarchy motion; avoid globally sampled world-rotation winding aliases.

Use Ground Pound-only fixed-length local IK for the new upper/forearm supports and retain the original local wrist grip. This preserves coherent stone shape and a raised wind-up/downstroke while deliberately changing the visible arm path.

prominent_limits: This is a new, unapproved articulated-stone interpretation. It is not lossless preservation of the former rendered arm motion.

Each stone is closed and rigid, but opposing cut rims rotate apart. Maximum sampled model-space separations are 0.230657 at the wrist, 0.335481 at the elbow and 0.314413 at the shoulder. Visible capped joint ends and openings need human judgment.

Physical ownership and joint pivots change the visible right arm in all eight clips. Ground Pound additionally uses new local IK curves and a coherent wrist-local grip. Original anatomical bone curves remain exact; that does not imply exact visible strike motion.

The source corrected fist reaches its lowest model Y at 1.566667 seconds; the new draft does so at 1.133333 seconds, about 0.433333 seconds earlier. Minimum model Y values are +0.022028 and +0.019035 respectively. These are not actual scene-plane ground-contact measurements.

The fixed physical arm has limited reach; some former wrist targets are unreachable. The Ground Pound wrist target is clamped by up to 0.166597 model units at delivered control keys. At some poses the hand remains higher or follows a different arc.

Sampled actual-client differences against the last reviewed f9 reach 2392.843 world millimetres on affected original rows. This measures the intentional redesign, not a fidelity error accepted under a relaxed threshold.
The calf, foot and thumb/calf topology repairs from f9 are retained. Existing unrelated model limitations are not all repaired by this arm draft.

Native finite/shape checks and fresh Blender import do not establish collision freedom, identical secondary effects, FPS performance or human approval. No runtime installation or push is authorized by this receipt.
